description: The print-languages verb names what analyze leaves out before any analyzer runs: a Go module holding a Protocol Buffers schema file puts proto in scope by its census, and an orchestrator that does not hold the proto reader leaves proto out, with a declared consumer holding only schema files, so the census names go alone and one left-out entry for proto naming the consumer, its reason the line analyze prints for it on standard error, without the product name, colon and space that open the line.

left_out.reason: this build of deadset holds no reader of "proto", so the run leaves it out of scope, and with it the consumer @TARGET@/schemas
